description: Reports upcoming or recent earnings, dividends, and stock splits from FMP for a watchlist of tickers. Accepts a comma-separated ticker list or a file of tickers. Returns events in a given date range (default 7 days ahead; use negative range like -30d to look back). Use when the user asks about upcoming or past corporate events, earnings dates, dividend schedules, or stock splits for specific tickers.
